artworks.title: Excellent placement
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image depicts two men standing in profile facing each other. The man on the left has curly hair and prominent facial features, wearing a dark jacket over a light-colored shirt and light trousers. The man on the right is holding a top hat, wearing a long dark coat with matching trousers and shoes. The background includes simple line drawings of an interior setting with an arched doorway or window and possibly a curtain or drapery.

artworks.title: The Old House, Cos Cob
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a rustic two-story building with a large tree on the right side, its branches extending across the scene. The viewpoint is slightly below the house's first floor, offering an upwards view to the upper porch with a railing. The house sits on a stone foundation with a wraparound porch. The horizon is concealed by the house and surrounding vegetation. The style seems to be an etching or detailed line drawing characterized by intricate lines indicating texture and shadow. The scene is monochromatic with light and dark variations created by line density. The garden or woodland surrounding the building is dense with foliage, adding depth. Stairs lead up to the entryway near us, and distant chimneys and wooden paneling contribute to the aged feel of the setting.

artworks.title: Old Chinatown, San Francisco
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of an interior courtyard with a staircase. The scene shows a narrow alley or courtyard with a central, wooden staircase leading upwards to a platform. The structure around the staircase is made of wooden beams and boards, and there are various objects scattered around the bottom of the staircase. A small figure stands at the top, highlighted by the lighter area around it. Natural light streams in from above, illuminating the textures and creating a serene atmosphere.

artworks.title: Heavy Surf, High Tide, Easthampton
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a seascape with a shoreline, ocean, and sky. The horizon is in the middle, the sky is dark with patches of light breaking through the clouds. Lines and textures are created by parallel and cross-hatched strokes, depicting waves. The shore has curved lines showing the tide. The color palette is monochromatic with dark ink and light paper. The ocean appears tumultuous, waves seem to roll towards the viewer, with cloudy and light patches in the distance.

artworks.title: Nude [recto]
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)

artworks.title: The Wild Cherry Tree
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a natural scene with a rocky landscape, sparse vegetation, rocks, and a nude figure partially hidden by foliage. The figure is seated, facing away from the viewer. The drawing is in monochrome with delicate lines and shading to depict texture and depth. The trees and foliage are drawn with a mix of short, quick strokes and softer lines.

artworks.title: Inner Harbor
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a coastal landscape with a body of water, buildings, and trees on the horizon. The artistic style uses sparse brushstrokes and a monochromatic color palette. Boats can be seen in the distance, with calm water in the foreground.

artworks.title: Virginia
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image depicts a young girl standing upright in a frontal view. She is shown from head to just below the knee. One of her arms rests on a rounded table draped with a cloth, while her other arm hangs by her side. She has a round face with neutral expressions, long, wavy hair that falls just past her shoulders, and is wearing a knee-length dress with a collar, buttons down the front, and short sleeves. The dress appears to have texture drawn with light pencil work. There is a bowl filled with round fruits on the table next to her. The background shows paneling, suggesting an indoor setting, possibly a domestic setting.

artworks.title: Colonial Church, Gloucester
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a tree-lined path with tall trees arched overhead. A building with a tower rises above the trees in the center of the image. Loose and expressive brushstrokes depict foliage and architectural details. The color palette is primarily in soft sepia tones, giving a classic feel to the scene. The path leads towards the building, which stands out against the trees in the distance.

artworks.title: Return of the Fleet
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a maritime scene with ships on the sea under a dramatic cloudy sky. The composition includes large ships near the horizon line and a smaller boat with figures closer to the viewer. The sky is filled with expressive pencil strokes representing clouds, with sunlight breaking through. The sketch uses a monochrome palette of graphite shades to create contrast.

artworks.title: New York Bouquet
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image features a tall building at the center of the composition, viewed from a street-level perspective. The building has detailed architectural features such as arched windows and layered sections, and extends upward towards the top edge of the image. A flag is shown to the right, adding movement and contrast. The artwork is created with sketch-like techniques, visible brushstrokes or pencil lines, and has a monochromatic color palette of black, grey, and cream.

artworks.title: Landscape, Land of Nod
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with trees, a horizon line, and a pathway. The view is slightly elevated, providing a broad perspective. Trees are spread throughout the scene, some prominently located in the center. The trees have leafy tops under a sky with a few small clouds. The image features sketch-like strokes, creating a textured and dynamic look. The color palette is mostly black and dark brown against a beige background, resembling a paper drawing. A winding pathway leads through the uneven terrain, drawing the eye towards distant hills with sparse vegetation.

artworks.title: New York Sky Line, Dark Buildings
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image depicts a cityscape with several tall buildings. The horizon line is low in the composition, highlighting the architectural silhouettes against the sky. The technique used is a form of sketching with stippled brushstrokes to suggest texture and detail. The color palette is mainly beige and black, creating a monochromatic contrast. Light cloud formations are sketched in the sky.

artworks.title: New York Sky Line, Light Buildings
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on smooth wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image features a cityscape with a cluster of buildings stretching towards the horizon. The skyline includes tall structures, with a tower topped by a flag standing out. The sketchy pencil strokes give the artwork an impressionistic quality, with a monochromatic color palette of black against a light beige background. Smaller buildings in the foreground contrast with the taller industrial structures in the distance. The sky is lightly sketched with horizontal lines suggesting clouds.

artworks.title: Afternoon Shadows
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a rural setting. There are buildings, including a house with a sloped roof, and smaller structures. The horizon line is visible near the middle of the composition. The brushstrokes convey texture and depth, especially in the foliage and ground. The color scheme is monochromatic, with black tones on a beige background. Large trees are on the left, and the foreground features rough terrain.

artworks.title: The Land of Nod
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape viewed from a slightly elevated position, showing a gently undulating terrain. The horizon is placed high in the composition, with trees and a small structure visible on it. The drawing features gestural pencil marks, creating a sketch-like quality with expressive lines capturing trees and the terrain. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of grey on a neutral beige background. Sparse clouds are seen in the sky. A prominent tree with arching branches is located in the foreground.

artworks.title: The Little School House, Land of Nod
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image depicts a tree-dotted landscape viewed from an elevated perspective. The sketch shows a horizon line with clustered trees and sparse structures indicating a distant settlement. The brushstrokes are varied and expressive, creating texture. The color palette is monochromatic, with shades of black on a pale beige background. A winding path separates open spaces and scattered trees in the foreground. The density of trees and structures increases towards the horizon line. The sky above has a few light strokes suggesting cloud cover or movement.

artworks.title: Lafayette Street
artworks.medium: lithotint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mrs. Childe Hassam, 1940)
artworks.description: The image shows an urban street scene viewed from above, with bustling activities below. The focus is on the street, buildings, figures, and carriages. The scene is depicted with loose brushstrokes in a monochromatic palette of blacks and grays against an off-white background, conveying movement and vibrancy. Figures in motion, including one looking towards the viewer, are close, while in the distance, large, vertically hanging flags are displayed. Surrounding buildings add to the busy city atmosphere.

artworks.title: Eucalyptus Trees
artworks.medium: etching in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Bequest of Frank B. Bristow, 1968)
artworks.description: The image displays a beach scene with a sandy pathway flanked by tall trees. The top portion shows textured leaves in intricate patterns. The horizon is prominent, showcasing the vast water body beyond the land. The style resembles etchings with fine details, cross-hatched lines, and stippled dots. The monochromatic color palette ranges from black to beige. In the distance, hills and a few human figures are barely visible, one of them seeming to use a rake in the serene coastal setting.

artworks.title: The Emigrant: A Cool Reception
artworks.medium: lithograph in black with hand coloring on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Alice F. Williams, 1958)
artworks.description: This is a painting of a donkey standing in the snow. The scene depicts a solitary donkey with a heavy mane and a slightly forlorn expression, standing amidst a wintry landscape. In the background, leafless trees, a snow-covered expanse, and distant rooftops are partially visible, suggesting a rural setting. In the foreground, a small, colorful bird perches on a branch. The painting is titled "The Emigrant: A Cool Reception" in the style of Currier and Ives.

artworks.title: Un monsieur tenant a prouver qu'il peut ...
artworks.medium: lithograph
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection
artworks.description: The image shows a person seated at a piano, leaning forward with their hands on the keys appearing to play and sing simultaneously. The person has short, dark, and combed-back hair, wearing a dark, striped jacket. In the background, there are other people, mostly men, observing. The setting is indoors with a music score on the piano and a candle holder with a lit candle to the side.

artworks.title: Rapids Above Hadley's Falls
artworks.artist: John Hill, after William Guy Wall
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1955)
artworks.description: The image displays a rocky ledge by a river, where a person is fishing. The horizon is visible with distant hills and wooded areas. A rugged cliff covered with trees lines the river, showcasing the water's movement. The brushstroke style offers detailed texture to the surfaces and water. The color palette includes earth tones like browns and greens for the terrain, contrasting with cool blues and whites in the river. The sky is a muted gray, indicating an overcast day.

artworks.title: United States Military Academy, Looking South
artworks.medium: hand-colored engraving and aquatint on wove paper mounted to paperboard
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Museum Purchase, Mary E. Maxwell Fund, 1955)
artworks.description: The image shows a military academy with large buildings and rolling hills. The horizon is near the upper third of the image, with the natural landscape rising just above the rooftops. In the distance, there are troops in formation near cannons under a sky with soft clouds. The brushstrokes are precise, creating a formal illustration style. In the foreground on the right, people in period attire gather near a white obelisk surrounded by an iron fence. An American flag flutters near the center. The ground shows textures of earth and grass, with figures reclining on the grass. The color palette consists of earth tones, green, beige, and muted blues.

artworks.title: Moonlight on the Androscoggin
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Corcoran Collection (Gift of Mr. S.R. Koehler, Boston, Massachusetts, 1881)
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a body of water, distant trees and hills on the horizon, a glowing moon reflecting in the water, cloudy sky, and a rocky terrain with a figure seated near the water.
